_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by month decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_ROLLING_MEAN group overlay that emits a per-point windowed index against the arithmetic mean of the W=3 immediately preceding points (point / rolling_mean * 100). Windowed-Process kind sharing the carrier shape with OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_ROLLING (22_process_zscore_vs_rolling.json) — both maintain a per-group ring buffer of the W most recent PRESENT values plus the Welford (count, mean, M2) trio. INDEX reads only the mean. Buffered (the ring buffer carrier widens past v1's single-state lag accumulator). Window-fill semantics: first W present ordinals emit NaN without warning. Zero rolling-mean emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO. Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 100.
_meta.name: process-index-vs-rolling-mean
